This directory runs DevTools network emulation tests with the
SocketLayerNetworkThrottling feature, which applies the emulated latency and
throughputs at the socket layer, while offline emulation still applies at the
request level.

Design doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1g5kFgBCKR1UItG5IW3QellAtvE8Dx1rfaqR3xfswjx8
